list:
# The page's pictures of Transfer at work, drawn in HTML and SVG rather than screenshots, so they
# stay sharp at any size and follow the theme. Sizes are in container units (cqw), so each
# picture scales as one. The words in them are the app's own: its columns, sheets, states, the
# clipboard bar, and the shelf's speed and time left, as `docs/SPEC.md` gives them.

import { Icon } from './icon.rip'

# A window's top bar: the three traffic lights.
Lights = component
  @big?: boolean := false
  render
    div class: ['flex', if big then 'gap-[1cqw]' else 'gap-[0.6cqw]']
      for color in ['bg-[#ff5f57]', 'bg-[#febc2e]', 'bg-[#28c840]']
        span class: ['rounded-full', color, if big then 'size-[1.9cqw]' else 'size-[1.1cqw]']

# A file's or folder's icon, as Finder draws them small: a blue folder, or a white page.
Glyph = component extends span
  @kind: string
  @live?: boolean := false
  render
    span class: 'relative inline-block shrink-0'
      if kind is 'folder'
        svg class: 'block size-full', viewBox: '0 0 20 20', aria-hidden: 'true'
          path d: 'M1.5 5A1.8 1.8 0 0 1 3.3 3.2h4.4l1.9 2h7.1a1.8 1.8 0 0 1 1.8 1.8v8.2a1.8 1.8 0 0 1-1.8 1.8H3.3a1.8 1.8 0 0 1-1.8-1.8Z', fill: '#3d9be9'
          path d: 'M1.5 7.4h17v7.8a1.8 1.8 0 0 1-1.8 1.8H3.3a1.8 1.8 0 0 1-1.8-1.8Z', fill: '#6cbaf6'
      else
        svg class: 'block size-full', viewBox: '0 0 20 20', aria-hidden: 'true'
          path d: 'M4.5 1.5h7.3l4.2 4.2v12a.8.8 0 0 1-.8.8H4.5a.8.8 0 0 1-.8-.8V2.3a.8.8 0 0 1 .8-.8Z', fill: 'white', stroke: '#b4c0cf', stroke-width: 1
          path d: 'M11.8 1.5v4.2H16', fill: '#e3e9f0', stroke: '#b4c0cf', stroke-width: 1, stroke-linejoin: 'round'
          path d: 'M6.5 9.5h7M6.5 12h7M6.5 14.5h4.5', stroke: '#c7d2de', stroke-width: 1.1, stroke-linecap: 'round'
      # A Live file's small red dot.
      if live
        span class: 'absolute -right-[12%] -bottom-[6%] size-[45%] rounded-full bg-live ring-[0.12cqw] ring-[var(--color-bg-surface)]'

# The red capsule a Live file shows in the toolbar and the preview panel.
Capsule = component extends span
  @text: string
  render
    span class: 'inline-flex shrink-0 items-center rounded-full bg-live px-[0.75em] py-[0.2em] leading-none font-bold tracking-wide text-white', text

# Text in the app's own syntax colors, line by line: each line is [kind, text] pairs.
Code = component
  @lines: any
  @dark?: boolean := false

  color: (kind) -> if dark then SYNTAX_DARK[kind] else SYNTAX[kind]

  render
    div class: 'font-mono'
      for line in lines
        div class: 'whitespace-pre'
          if line.length is 0
            span ' '
          for token in line
            span class: color(token[0]), token[1]

SYNTAX =! {
  '': 'text-primary'
  k: 'text-keyword font-semibold'
  s: 'text-string'
  c: 'text-comment'
  n: 'text-number'
  t: 'text-type'
}

# An editor's dark colors, whatever the page's theme.
SYNTAX_DARK =! {
  '': 'text-white/85'
  k: 'text-[#fc5fa3] font-semibold'
  s: 'text-[#fc6a5d]'
  c: 'text-[#7f8c98]'
  n: 'text-[#d0bf69]'
  t: 'text-[#5dd8ff]'
}

APP_JS =! [
  [['k', 'import'], ['', ' { serve } '], ['k', 'from'], ['', ' '], ['s', "'./server.js'"]]
  [['k', 'import'], ['', ' { log } '], ['k', 'from'], ['', ' '], ['s', "'./log.js'"]]
  []
  [['k', 'const'], ['', ' port = '], ['t', 'Number'], ['', '(process.env.PORT ?? '], ['n', '8080'], ['', ')']]
  [['k', 'const'], ['', ' root = '], ['s', "'public'"]]
  []
  [['c', '// Saved in the editor, uploaded by Transfer.']]
  [['k', 'export function'], ['', ' start() {']]
  [['', '  log('], ['s', "'listening on'"], ['', ', port)']]
  [['', '  '], ['k', 'return'], ['', ' serve({ port, root })']]
  [['', '}']]
  []
  [['k', 'export function'], ['', ' stop(server) {']]
  [['', '  server.close()']]
  [['', '}']]
  []
  [['', 'start()']]
]

# The hero: Transfer's window on a desktop, browsing a server in list view. The sidebar holds the
# servers, stars, and Live files; the preview panel shows the selected file, Live, as highlighted
# text; the path bar is along the foot, and a download on the shelf shows its speed and time left.
export Hero = component
  render
    div class: '@container w-full'
      div class: 'relative aspect-[16/10] w-full overflow-hidden rounded-[1.6cqw] text-left glow ring-1 ring-black/10 dark:ring-white/10'
        div class: 'absolute inset-0 brand-gradient'
        div class: 'absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top_left,rgb(255_255_255/0.35),transparent_60%)]'
        # The menu bar.
        div class: 'absolute inset-x-0 top-0 flex h-[2.8cqw] items-center gap-[2cqw] bg-black/15 px-[2cqw] text-[1.15cqw] font-medium text-white backdrop-blur-sm'
          span class: 'font-bold', 'Transfer'
          for item in ['File', 'Edit', 'View', 'Go', 'Window', 'Help']
            span class: 'text-white/90', item
          span class: 'ml-auto', 'Mon 9:41 AM'
        # The window.
        div class: 'absolute top-[7%] right-[3%] bottom-[4%] left-[3%] flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-[1.2cqw] bg-surface text-[1.1cqw] shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-black/10 dark:ring-white/15'
          # The toolbar: sidebar, Back and Forward, the title, then LIVE, the views, Transfers,
          # the inspector, and search, in the app's order.
          div class: 'flex h-[4.6cqw] shrink-0 items-center gap-[1.2cqw] border-b border-surface px-[1.6cqw] text-secondary'
            Lights
            Icon name: 'panel-left', class: 'ml-[1cqw] size-[1.7cqw]'
            div class: 'ml-[4.6cqw] flex items-center gap-[0.4cqw] rounded-full bg-muted px-[0.8cqw] py-[0.45cqw]'
              Icon name: 'chevron-left', class: 'size-[1.6cqw]'
              Icon name: 'chevron-right', class: 'size-[1.6cqw] opacity-35'
            div class: 'flex flex-col leading-tight'
              span class: 'text-[1.25cqw] font-bold text-primary', 'www'
              span class: 'text-[0.95cqw] text-tertiary', 'live'
            div class: 'ml-auto flex items-center gap-[1.1cqw]'
              Capsule text: 'LIVE 2', class: 'text-[0.95cqw]'
              div class: 'flex items-center gap-[0.3cqw] rounded-full bg-muted p-[0.3cqw]'
                span class: 'px-[0.6cqw] py-[0.3cqw]'
                  Icon name: 'grid', class: 'size-[1.5cqw]'
                span class: 'rounded-full bg-surface px-[0.6cqw] py-[0.3cqw] text-primary shadow-sm'
                  Icon name: 'list', class: 'size-[1.5cqw]'
                span class: 'px-[0.6cqw] py-[0.3cqw]'
                  Icon name: 'columns', class: 'size-[1.5cqw]'
              span class: 'rounded-full bg-muted p-[0.6cqw]'
                Icon name: 'arrow-up-down', class: 'size-[1.5cqw]'
              span class: 'rounded-full bg-muted p-[0.6cqw] text-accent'
                Icon name: 'panel-right', class: 'size-[1.5cqw]'
              span class: 'rounded-full bg-muted p-[0.6cqw]'
                Icon name: 'search', class: 'size-[1.5cqw]'

          div class: 'flex min-h-0 flex-1'
            # The sidebar.
            div class: 'flex w-[16cqw] shrink-0 flex-col gap-[0.25cqw] border-r border-surface bg-muted/60 p-[1cqw]'
              for group in SIDEBAR
                div class: 'mt-[0.6cqw] px-[0.6cqw] pb-[0.2cqw] text-[0.9cqw] font-semibold text-tertiary', group.title
                for row in group.rows
                  div class: ['flex items-center gap-[0.7cqw] rounded-[0.5cqw] px-[0.6cqw] py-[0.35cqw]', if row.selected then 'bg-primary/10 font-medium' else 'text-secondary']
                    if row.kind is 'server'
                      Icon name: 'server', class: 'size-[1.4cqw] text-accent'
                    else
                      Glyph kind: row.kind, live: row.live, class: 'size-[1.5cqw]'
                    span row.name

            # The list.
            div class: 'flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col'
              div class: 'flex h-[2.4cqw] shrink-0 items-center border-b border-surface px-[1.2cqw] text-[0.95cqw] font-medium text-tertiary'
                span class: 'w-[38%]', 'Name'
                span class: 'w-[31%]', 'Date Modified'
                span class: 'w-[10%] pr-[1.2cqw] text-right', 'Size'
                span class: 'flex-1', 'Kind'
              div class: 'min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden px-[0.5cqw] pt-[0.3cqw]'
                for row, i in ROWS
                  div class: ['flex h-[2.3cqw] items-center rounded-[0.5cqw] px-[0.7cqw]', if row.selected then 'bg-accent text-white' else (if i % 2 is 1 then 'bg-muted/70' else '')]
                    span class: 'flex w-[38%] items-center gap-[0.7cqw] truncate'
                      Glyph kind: (if row.folder then 'folder' else 'file'), live: row.live, class: 'size-[1.5cqw]'
                      span class: (if row.selected then 'font-medium' else ''), row.name
                    span class: ['w-[31%] truncate', if row.selected then 'text-white/85' else 'text-secondary'], row.date
                    span class: ['w-[10%] pr-[1.2cqw] text-right whitespace-pre tabular-nums', if row.selected then 'text-white/85' else 'text-secondary'], row.size
                    span class: ['flex-1 truncate', if row.selected then 'text-white/85' else 'text-secondary'], row.kind
              # The path bar.
              div class: 'flex h-[2.4cqw] shrink-0 items-center gap-[0.6cqw] border-t border-surface px-[1.2cqw] text-[0.95cqw] text-secondary'
                Icon name: 'server', class: 'size-[1.2cqw] text-accent'
                span 'live'
                for name in ['var', 'www']
                  span class: 'text-tertiary', '›'
                  Glyph kind: 'folder', class: 'size-[1.3cqw]'
                  span name
                span class: 'text-tertiary', '›'
                Glyph kind: 'file', class: 'size-[1.3cqw]'
                span class: 'text-primary', 'app.js'

            # The preview panel: one line of facts, then the preview filling the rest.
            div class: 'flex w-[30cqw] shrink-0 flex-col gap-[0.9cqw] border-l border-surface p-[1.1cqw]'
              div class: 'flex items-center gap-[0.6cqw] whitespace-nowrap'
                Glyph kind: 'file', live: true, class: 'size-[1.5cqw]'
                span class: 'font-bold', 'app.js'
                span class: 'text-tertiary tabular-nums whitespace-pre', '18kB  2026-10-26  9:41 AM'
                Capsule text: 'LIVE', class: 'ml-auto text-[0.8cqw]'
              div class: 'min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-[0.5cqw] border border-surface bg-page p-[1.1cqw] text-[0.92cqw] leading-[1.65]'
                Code lines: APP_JS
              div class: 'flex items-center gap-[0.5cqw] text-[0.9cqw] text-secondary'
                span class: 'flex size-[1.1cqw] items-center justify-center rounded-[0.25cqw] bg-accent text-white'
                  Icon name: 'check', class: 'size-[0.9cqw]', strokeWidth: 3
                'Wrap lines'

          # The shelf: one download, with its bar, its speed, and the time left.
          div class: 'flex h-[4.4cqw] shrink-0 items-center gap-[1.2cqw] border-t border-surface bg-muted/50 px-[1.6cqw]'
            Icon name: 'arrow-up-down', class: 'size-[1.7cqw] text-accent'
            div class: 'flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-[0.45cqw]'
              div class: 'flex items-baseline gap-[1cqw] whitespace-nowrap'
                span class: 'font-semibold', 'Download releases'
                span class: 'text-tertiary tabular-nums', '1.4GB of 2.9GB'
                span class: 'ml-auto text-secondary tabular-nums', '12MB/s · about 2 minutes left'
              div class: 'h-[0.5cqw] overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-tertiary/20'
                div class: 'h-full animate-[fill_9s_linear_infinite] rounded-full bg-accent', style: 'width: 48%'
            span class: 'flex size-[1.8cqw] items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-tertiary/20 text-secondary'
              Icon name: 'x', class: 'size-[1.1cqw]', strokeWidth: 3

SIDEBAR =! [
  { title: 'Servers', rows: [{ kind: 'server', name: 'live', selected: true }, { kind: 'server', name: 'staging' }, { kind: 'server', name: 'pi' }] }
  { title: 'Starred', rows: [{ kind: 'folder', name: 'releases' }, { kind: 'file', name: 'nginx.conf' }] }
  { title: 'Live Files', rows: [{ kind: 'file', name: 'app.js', live: true }, { kind: 'file', name: 'styles.css', live: true }] }
]

  { name: 'logs', folder: true, date: 'Oct 26, 2026 at 9:40 AM', size: '', kind: 'Folder' }
  { name: 'releases', folder: true, date: 'Oct 24, 2026 at 8:02 AM', size: '', kind: 'Folder' }
  { name: 'README', date: 'Oct 12, 2026 at 3:18 PM', size: '2.9kB', kind: 'Plain Text' }
  { name: 'app.js', date: 'Oct 26, 2026 at 9:41 AM', size: ' 18kB', kind: 'JavaScript script', live: true, selected: true }
  { name: 'backup.tar.gz', date: 'Oct 25, 2026 at 2:00 AM', size: '1.2GB', kind: 'gzip archive' }
  { name: 'index.html', date: 'Oct 22, 2026 at 11:05 AM', size: '6.1kB', kind: 'HTML text' }
  { name: 'logo.png', date: 'Sep 30, 2026 at 5:47 PM', size: '212kB', kind: 'PNG image' }
  { name: 'package.json', date: 'Oct 20, 2026 at 10:33 AM', size: '1.4kB', kind: 'JSON' }
  { name: 'styles.css', date: 'Oct 26, 2026 at 9:38 AM', size: '9.8kB', kind: 'CSS style sheet', live: true }
]

STYLES_CSS =! [
  [['t', '.hero'], ['', ' {']]
  [['', '  padding: '], ['n', '4rem'], ['', ' '], ['n', '1rem'], ['', ';']]
  [['', '  color: '], ['k', 'var'], ['', '(--ink);']]
  [['', '  background: '], ['s', '#0346a6'], ['', ';']]
  [['', '  border-radius: '], ['n', '12px'], ['', ';']]
  [['', '}']]
]

LIVE_ROWS =! [
  { name: 'app.js', server: 'live', state: 'Synced' }
  { name: 'styles.css', server: 'live', state: 'Uploading', busy: true }
  { name: 'config.yml', server: 'staging', state: 'Conflict', conflict: true }
]

# Live files: an editor saving a file, and the list the toolbar's LIVE capsule opens, with every
# Live file on every server, its state, and Stop.
export LiveFiles = component
  render
    div class: '@container w-full'
      div class: 'relative aspect-[4/3] w-full overflow-hidden rounded-[2cqw] bg-muted text-left ring-1 ring-black/5 dark:ring-white/10'
        # Transfer's toolbar, with the capsule pressed.
        div class: 'absolute top-[6%] right-[5%] left-[38%] flex h-[9cqw] items-center gap-[2cqw] rounded-[1.6cqw] bg-surface px-[2.4cqw] text-secondary shadow-lg'
          Icon name: 'chevron-left', class: 'size-[2.8cqw]'
          span class: 'text-[2.3cqw] font-bold text-primary', 'www'
          Capsule text: 'LIVE 3', class: 'ml-auto text-[1.9cqw]'
          Icon name: 'list', class: 'size-[2.8cqw]'
          Icon name: 'panel-right', class: 'size-[2.8cqw]'
        # The list it opens.
        div class: 'absolute top-[22%] right-[5%] z-10 w-[56%] rounded-[1.8cqw] bg-surface text-[2.1cqw] shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-black/5 dark:ring-white/10'
          span class: 'absolute -top-[1.2cqw] right-[21%] size-[2.6cqw] rotate-45 rounded-[0.4cqw] bg-surface'
          div class: 'relative border-b border-surface px-[2.4cqw] pt-[2cqw] pb-[1.4cqw] text-[2.3cqw] font-semibold', 'Live Files'
          for row in LIVE_ROWS
            div class: 'flex items-center gap-[1.6cqw] border-b border-surface px-[2.4cqw] py-[1.5cqw]'
              Glyph kind: 'file', live: true, class: 'size-[3.4cqw]'
              div class: 'flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col leading-tight'
                span class: 'font-medium', row.name
                span class: ['text-[1.75cqw]', if row.conflict then 'font-semibold text-live' else 'text-tertiary']
                  "#{row.server} · #{row.state}"
              if row.busy
                span class: 'size-[2cqw] animate-spin rounded-full border-[0.4cqw] border-accent/25 border-t-accent'
              span class: 'rounded-[0.8cqw] border border-strong px-[1.4cqw] py-[0.5cqw] text-[1.8cqw] font-medium', 'Stop'
          div class: 'flex justify-end px-[2.4cqw] py-[1.6cqw]'
            span class: 'rounded-[0.8cqw] border border-strong px-[1.4cqw] py-[0.5cqw] text-[1.8cqw] font-medium', 'Stop All'
        # The editor, where the save happens.
        div class: 'absolute top-[30%] bottom-[7%] left-[4%] w-[33%] overflow-hidden rounded-[1.6cqw] bg-neutral-900 text-white shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-white/10'
          div class: 'flex h-[6cqw] items-center gap-[1.6cqw] border-b border-white/10 px-[2cqw]'
            Lights big: true
            span class: 'text-[1.9cqw] text-white/70', 'styles.css'
          div class: 'p-[2.2cqw] text-[1.6cqw] leading-[1.75]'
            Code lines: STYLES_CSS, dark: true
          # The save, going up.
          div class: 'absolute right-[7%] bottom-[6%] left-[7%] flex items-center gap-[1.2cqw] rounded-[1.2cqw] bg-white/10 px-[1.6cqw] py-[1.1cqw] text-[1.7cqw] font-medium whitespace-nowrap'
            span class: 'rounded-[0.6cqw] border border-white/30 border-b-[0.35cqw] px-[0.9cqw] font-semibold', '⌘S'
            span class: 'text-white/80', 'uploads'
            span class: 'ml-auto flex size-[3.4cqw] items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-accent'
              Icon name: 'upload', class: 'size-[2cqw] animate-[rise_2.4s_ease-in-out_infinite]', strokeWidth: 2.5

# A conflict: the server's file changed under a save, and Transfer asks rather than overwrite.
export Conflict = component
  render
    div class: '@container w-full'
      div class: 'relative w-full overflow-hidden rounded-[2.6cqw] bg-surface p-[4.5cqw] text-left shadow-xl ring-1 ring-black/5 dark:ring-white/10'
        div class: 'flex items-start gap-[4cqw]'
          Glyph kind: 'file', live: true, class: 'size-[9cqw]'
          div class: 'min-w-0 flex-1'
            p class: 'text-[3.4cqw] font-bold leading-snug', '“config.yml” changed on the server'
            p class: 'mt-[1.2cqw] text-[2.9cqw] leading-snug text-secondary', 'Your save was not uploaded, and nothing was overwritten.'
        div class: 'mt-[4cqw] flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-[1.6cqw] text-[2.9cqw] font-medium whitespace-nowrap'
          for label in ['Later', 'Compare', 'Keep Local', 'Keep Remote']
            span class: 'rounded-[1.2cqw] border border-strong px-[2.4cqw] py-[0.6cqw]', label
          span class: 'rounded-[1.2cqw] bg-accent px-[2.4cqw] py-[0.6cqw] text-white', 'Keep Both'

# Copy and drag: a Transfer window with three files and a folder copied (the clipboard bar names
# them), dragged onto a Finder window, where they land as real files.
export Dragging = component
  render
    div class: '@container w-full'
      div class: 'relative aspect-[4/3] w-full overflow-hidden rounded-[2cqw] bg-muted text-left ring-1 ring-black/5 dark:ring-white/10'
        # The Finder window.
        div class: 'absolute top-[40%] bottom-[7%] left-[5%] w-[50%] overflow-hidden rounded-[1.6cqw] bg-surface shadow-xl'
          div class: 'flex h-[6.4cqw] items-center gap-[2cqw] border-b border-surface px-[2.2cqw]'
            Lights big: true
            span class: 'text-[2.2cqw] font-bold', 'Downloads'
          div class: 'grid grid-cols-3 gap-[2.4cqw] p-[3cqw]'
            for item in [['folder', 'Archive'], ['file', 'invoice.pdf'], ['file', 'notes.md'], ['folder', 'Photos'], ['file', 'report.key']]
              div class: 'flex flex-col items-center gap-[0.8cqw]'
                Glyph kind: item[0], class: 'size-[7cqw]'
                span class: 'max-w-full truncate text-[1.7cqw] text-secondary', item[1]
        # The Transfer window.
        div class: 'absolute top-[7%] right-[5%] w-[56%] overflow-hidden rounded-[1.6cqw] bg-surface shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-black/5 dark:ring-white/10'
          div class: 'flex h-[6.4cqw] items-center gap-[2cqw] border-b border-surface px-[2.2cqw]'
            Lights big: true
            div class: 'flex flex-col leading-tight'
              span class: 'text-[2.2cqw] font-bold', 'releases'
              span class: 'text-[1.6cqw] text-tertiary', 'live'
          div class: 'px-[1.2cqw] py-[1cqw] text-[1.9cqw]'
            for row, i in DRAG_ROWS
              div class: ['flex items-center gap-[1.2cqw] rounded-[0.8cqw] px-[1.2cqw] py-[0.7cqw]', if row[2] then 'bg-accent text-white' else '']
                Glyph kind: row[0], class: 'size-[2.6cqw]'
                span class: 'flex-1 truncate', row[1]
                span class: ['whitespace-pre tabular-nums', if row[2] then 'text-white/80' else 'text-tertiary'], row[3]
          # The clipboard bar.
          div class: 'flex items-center gap-[1.6cqw] border-t border-surface border-l-[0.6cqw] border-l-[#ffcc00] bg-[#ffcc00]/14 px-[2cqw] py-[1.2cqw]'
            Icon name: 'clipboard', class: 'size-[2.6cqw] shrink-0 text-[#e6b800]'
            div class: 'flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col leading-tight'
              span class: 'truncate text-[1.75cqw] font-medium', 'Copied 3 files and 1 folder (31 files in all, 12MB)'
              span class: 'truncate text-[1.45cqw] text-tertiary', 'from live · ⌘V pastes, ⌥⌘V moves, Esc clears · Finder can paste it too'
            Icon name: 'x', class: 'size-[2cqw] shrink-0 text-tertiary', strokeWidth: 3
        # What is being dragged, on its way to the Finder.
        div class: 'absolute top-[24%] left-[56%] animate-[drag_5s_ease-in-out_infinite]'

# A command to paste into Terminal, with a button that copies it.
export Command = component
  @text: string

    copied = true
    setTimeout((-> copied = false), 1600)

  render
    div class: 'group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-code py-3 pr-2 pl-4 font-mono text-sm text-white/90 shadow-lg'
      if prompt

      button
        type: 'button'
        class: 'flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-white/60 transition hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white'
        aria-label: if copied then 'Copied' else 'Copy the command'
        @click: copy
        Icon name: (if copied then 'check' else 'copy'), class: 'size-4'

# Light or dark: the head of the page set one already, and this switches and remembers it.
export ThemeToggle = component
  theme := document.documentElement.dataset.theme or 'light'

  ~> document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme

  toggle: ->
    theme = if theme is 'dark' then 'light' else 'dark'
    try localStorage.setItem('theme', theme)

  render
    button
      type: 'button'
      class: 'flex size-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-tertiary transition hover:bg-muted hover:text-primary'
      aria-label: if theme is 'dark' then 'Switch to the light theme' else 'Switch to the dark theme'
      @click: toggle
      Icon name: (if theme is 'dark' then 'sun' else 'moon'), class: 'size-4.5'
